'''2023 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event in Seattle, Washington, 27–29 October 2023. [[Hayes Hunter]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-08-endor-grand-prix-seattle-washington-oct-27-29/</ref> Friday team event winners: [[Blake Silkwood]] and [[Ryan Sersen]].<ref name="wrap">https://www.starwarsccg.org/egp-2023-wrap-up-hayes-hunter-on-a-roll-takes-title/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Seattle, Washington
* '''Dates:''' 27–29 October 2023
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83759 forum]
